summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Maurice Nicolle, a French physician and microbiologist. It gives his birthplace (Rouen) and lifespan (1862–1932) and notes that he was the brother of the biologist Charles Nicolle (1866–1936).
one_line: Biographical entry for Maurice Nicolle, French physician and microbiologist born in Rouen, brother of biologist Charles Nicolle.
